_README: Maps every behavioral-gate CHECK emitted by qa/assert_behavioral.py to a root-cause CATEGORY, candidate code locations, an exact retest command, and a one-line hint. Consumed by qa/root_cause_analyzer.py to turn a RED gate into actionable locations. PURE METADATA — no code reads/writes product state from here. Categories: ENGINE_INVARIANT (a state-integrity fact the engine, the sole writer, must hold), DM_ADHERENCE (the DM agent's play behavior — what it narrated / resolved / which features it used), HARNESS_WIRING (the QA plumbing itself — the player facade, the moves/chat logs, honesty stamps, version-skew tool rejections). Keep this in sync when a chk() name is added/removed in assert_behavioral.py. An UNKNOWN check (not listed here) degrades gracefully in the analyzer to category UNKNOWN with a generic hint.
_retest_note: Retest commands re-run the relevant QA lane; they DO NOT write committed artifacts. run_duo.sh / run_combat_sprint.sh write only under qa/transcripts/ + qa/state/<RUN>/ (gitignored run scratch). Re-run the SAME run id to re-score the same artifacts, or a fresh id for a new playtest.

dm_produced_output.hint: The run produced zero DM text and zero tool calls — a dead/blank run. Usually a masked cold-open auth failure (claude -p 401 / apiKeySource:none) or a DM agent that never started. Check the claude login first, then the DM spawn args in run_duo.sh.

both_sides_acted.hint: Only one side took turns in the duo (e.g. 1 player turn, 0 DM turns). The chat-loop wiring stalled — inspect the beat driver's player<->DM relay and the DM turn deadline.

player_turns_structured.hint: A player turn arrived as RAW text instead of a [tagged] move ([say]/[do]/[check]/[cast]/[use]/[attack]) — the player bypassed the facade (0-tools fallback). Check the player tool surface in player_server.py and the --permission-mode on the player spawn.

player_in_lane.hint: A legacy (non-facade) player turn looks like over-writing the world / asserting an outcome (DM-voice prose, 'you see…', 'rolls a…'). The structural fix is the constrained facade; tighten the player prompt meanwhile.

dm_voices_characters.hint: Zero quoted dialogue across the whole run with a companion present — a log, not a scene. The DM narrated only atmosphere. Strengthen the DM prompt's dialogue mandate; it is FATAL only when a companion is in the party.

narration_no_ooc_leak.hint: Player-facing DM prose leaked OUT-OF-CHARACTER craft-scaffolding / first-person authoring preambles / raw system vocab (e.g. 'Now let me seat <X> as the player character', 'Continuity check — let me correct that') — a felt-quality defect the LLM story scorer blends away. Fix at the source: the DM's FICTION-ONLY voice mandate in skills/dungeon-master/SKILL.md (and the duo DM prompt qa/play_dm_duo.txt). Proportionate severity: 0 leaks pass, 1-2 incidental leaks WARN, >=3 in a substantial run (dm_text>=MIN_BEATS) is a pervasively-broken player surface => RED. If a clean in-fiction beat is mis-flagged, tighten the _NARRATION_LEAK_RE patterns in qa/assert_behavioral.py.

dm_beat_honesty.hint: Beats were stamped beat_failed / fallback_recovered (a dead or error-class DM turn whose prose was recovered from the engine log via the #357 fallback). Report-only; investigate WHY the DM turn died (timeout / auth / tool error) in the beat driver.

player_used_facade.hint: Zero facade moves recorded — the player's tools were blocked or unused (often a missing --permission-mode on the player spawn). Check the player_server.py tool registration and the player spawn args + MOVES log wiring.

dm_resolved_player_moves.hint: The player declared a [cast]/[attack]/[check]/[save] but the DM made ZERO matching engine calls — the player was ignored while the DM narrated its own story. Reinforce the DM's 'resolve the declared move' instruction; confirm the engine tool exists for that move kind.

player_engaged.hint: A trivially short session (<3 moves) — possibly the run was cut off, the budget was tiny, or the player quit early. Check the beat budget and player prompt; WARN only.

player_probed.hint: The AI player asked 0 questions and requested 0 checks across the session — it played along as a passive plot-passenger. Add clarify/request_check guidance to the player prompt; WARN only (agency smell).

combat_not_left_active.hint: combat.active was still True at end-of-run — a finished session should end_combat. Either the DM never called end_combat (DM adherence) or end_combat failed to clear the flag (engine). Check the combat.active write in combat.py end_combat.

action_economy_engaged.hint: start_combat fired but the combat block shows no action consumed (action_used / attacks_made all falsy). Check that combat.py records action use; WARN only (snapshot may have reset the field).

round1_turn_skipped.hint: start_combat -> next_turn with NO resolving action (attack/cast_spell/saving_throw/use_action) in between — the first combatant's Round-1 turn was advanced without acting. Reinforce 'read turn_brief, resolve the full action (Multiattack = all N), THEN next_turn' in the DM prompt. WARN only.

combat_ran_outside_initiative.hint: >=3 attacks but start_combat never called — a fight ran entirely outside initiative, so turn-order/action-economy gates were inert. The engine surfaces a combat_not_active nudge per out-of-combat attack; reinforce 'call start_combat at the top of any real encounter' in the DM prompt. WARN only.

party_location_coherence.hint: A party member's location_id != current_location_id — party split / stale location. Check the relocate sweep (_move_party_to / travel_to in travel.py) co-locates the whole party. WARN only.

duration_expiry.hint: Combat is over but a character still carries a rounds/minutes active_effect — a duration expiry tick was missed. Check the effect-expiry sweep on end_combat / time advance in combat.py / models.py. WARN only.

dice_used.hint: A whole session with ZERO dice (roll/attack/saving_throw/social_check/skill_check). The DM resolved everything by fiat. Reinforce 'roll the dice via the engine' in the DM prompt; confirm the roll tools are registered in server.py.

combat_resolved.hint: start_combat fired but no attack/cast_spell/saving_throw resolved the fight (spawn_monster alone is not enough). The DM started a fight and never threw a die. Reinforce combat-resolution in the DM prompt; confirm the resolution tools exist in combat.py.

combat_ended.hint: start_combat fired but end_combat never did — combat may be left hanging (could be a run cut off mid-fight, so WARN). Reinforce 'end_combat when the fight concludes' in the DM prompt.

xp_awarded.hint: Combat ran but neither award_xp nor end_combat fired, so no XP for the fight. In xp mode end_combat auto-awards; the DM likely skipped end_combat. Reinforce the end-of-fight close-out in the DM prompt. WARN only.

xp_not_orphaned.hint: A defeated monster (dead=true) kept xp_value>0 after combat ended — the kill-time XP award never fired or was bypassed, so progression was SILENTLY LOST. This is a state-integrity defect in the engine's kill-time award path (combat.py). FATAL.

player_in_party.hint: No kind='player' character in state.party — the PC was never seated, or was dropped. Check the load_canon_character / create_character(kind='player', add_to_party=true) path and the party-membership write in server.py.

caster_has_spellbook.hint: A player/companion with truthy spellcasting but EMPTY spells (spells_known/cantrips_known/prepared_spells/cantrips) — the empty-spellbook regression. Check load_canon_character / class-default population in content.py + spells.py. WARN only.

quest_objectives_progress.hint: A quest status=completed with objectives but EMPTY completed_objectives — the complete_objective write-site was bypassed (DM narrated the goal done without recording it). Check the complete_objective / complete_quest writers in server.py + models.py. WARN only.

no_duplicate_companion.hint: Two companions share a name — the engine's dedup guard did not hold. Check the companion-add / recruit path in companion.py + server.py for the duplicate-name guard.

world_advanced_time.hint: After a substantial session the clock never moved (still day 1, morning) — a frozen scene. Either the DM never called advance_time/travel_to(advance_time=True)/long_rest (DM adherence) or the time write failed (engine). Check campaign_calendar.py + the advance_time write.

party_traveled.hint: The party visited <2 locations after a substantial session — it never left the opening scene. Either the DM never called travel_to/add_location(make_current=True) (DM adherence) or the location.visited flag never set (engine). Check travel.py's visited-marking write.

structural_completeness.hint: A >=10-beat session with a companion never engaged a core relationship/quest system: either no companion's attitude_value moved off 0 AND no camp/long_rest happened, or an active quest was left open across a >=2-location arc with no quest-resolution call. Either the DM never invoked the relationship/quest tools (record_decision / adjust_attitude / camp_scene / complete_quest evolves_to — DM adherence) or those engine writes never landed (engine). All those tool handlers + the attitude_value/quest-status writes live in server.py (adjust_attitude, record_decision, camp_scene, complete_quest, and the rule-of-three evolution _maybe_schedule_quest_evolution / evolves_to); the field definitions are in models.py; companion.py only surfaces approval CAUSES (approval_tags) for the DM to apply — it never writes state itself. The gate trips at >=10 beats (STRUCTURAL_MIN_BEATS). #1036 scope guard (Option A, mirrors #1030): on an AUTHORED campaign (start_adventure in the tool stream OR a non-empty state["scenes"]) whose only open quest is the hook-seeded arc, the unresolved-arc sub-check (b) is demoted FATAL->WARN — the hook-seeded campaign arc is multi-session by design and authored adventures author no closable sub-quests, so it no longer false-caps a clean authored run to 2.5; the WARN message is still surfaced. STILL FATAL for: any NON-authored run (the original narrated-not-engaged failure), and an authored run that called add_quest and left it unresolved (a real dropped DM-opened thread). Clause (a) approval-frozen is FATAL ALWAYS. Skipped in the combat-sprint lane.

flat_arc.hint: A >=24-beat run (FELT_SHAPE_MIN_BEATS, strictly above the >=10 structural floor) covered 3+ acts but the arc never TURNED — no midpoint reversal AND/OR no late climax landed (a flat fetch-quest shape, not a felt setup->reversal->climax). DM adherence: drive a real midpoint reversal + a late climax (record_decision the turning beat, advance_act / mark_reversal / mark_climax, complete_quest the spine late). The felt_shape fields (reversal/climax/acts_engine_reached/acts_tag_reached) are produced by the acts-engine in server.py (NarrativeArc + advance_act/mark_reversal/mark_climax) and surfaced via qa/story_readout.py's felt_shape_from_state. WARN only (fatal=False); only armed at >=24 beats so shorter runs are unaffected.

dm_advanced_time.hint: The DM never issued a time-advance tool across the session — only the harness soft-tick moved the clock, so companion regard / camp / day-gated systems stay starved (#1024 unmasks the frozen-DM the soft-tick hid). DM adherence: call long_rest / advance_time / downtime when a beat should pass time. The time-advance tools live in server.py. WARN only (fatal=False).

world_peopled.hint: <2 NPCs engaged (met) across the session — the world sat in the seeded roster, no new faces. The DM under-populated the scene. Reinforce 'introduce and meet new NPCs' in the DM prompt; confirm the npc.met write in npc.py. WARN only.

no_rejected_tool_calls.hint: A tool call was REJECTED with a schema/validation error (extra_forbidden => version skew or a wrong field). The DM's intent silently did not take effect — classic version-skew between the DM's expected tool schema and the engine's models. Check the tool param schema in server.py / models.py vs what the DM sent. FATAL.

engine_guards_hit.hint: Recoverable engine-guard rejections (e.g. travel-graph guards) the DM is expected to retry. Not a bug per se — confirm the DM recovered. Check the guard message in server.py/travel.py and whether the DM re-asked. WARN only.

tool_soft_errors.hint: A tool returned a dict {'error': ...} with is_error=False (load_canon_character miss, bestiary miss, dead-PC path) — invisible to the strict A8 gate. Recoverable; the DM is told and re-asks. Check the soft-error return site for the named tool. WARN only.

end_combat_no_living_hostiles.hint: end_combat was called but a hostile is still alive (current_hp>0, dead=false) with no flee/surrender/retreat recorded — corrupts the save for the next load. The DM should pass end_combat(resolution=...) or the engine should set last_combat_resolution. Check combat.py end_combat. FATAL outside combat-sprint.

xp_awarded_on_progression.hint: An xp-mode session advanced and crossed a reward-worthy seam (combat completion / completed quest / defeated XP monster) but every living party member is at 0 XP — progression/reward parity regression. Check the XP-award write paths in combat.py / encounter.py. FATAL.

xp_progression_scope.hint: An xp-mode session advanced but crossed NO reward seam (no combat/quest/explicit-reward/defeated-XP monster) — classified as setup/provider-proof scope rather than missing XP. Informational; usually expected for a short setup run. WARN only.

companion_location_synced.hint: A party/companion (including de-facto companions NOT in state.party[]) is not at current_location_id. Check the _move_party_to co-location sweep in travel.py covers all kind='companion', not just party[] members. WARN only.

companion_location_synced_on_travel.hint: After travel occurred (day>1 or >=2 visited), a companion is still not at the party's current location — the relocate sweep missed a de-facto companion. Same fix as companion_location_synced, scoped to post-travel. Check travel_to / _move_party_to in travel.py. WARN only.

companion_xp_synced_on_award.hint: The PC earned XP but a LIVING co-located companion is still at 0 — the companion was excluded from the party XP split. Check the XP-award split path (combat.py / encounter.py) includes co-located kind='companion'. WARN only.

caster_has_signature_proficiency.hint: A leveled caster/martial has a COMPLETELY EMPTY skill_proficiencies list (the load_canon_character gap: it skips _apply_srd_class_defaults). Check the SRD class-default application in content.py + srd_tables.py. WARN only.

fighter_second_wind_considered.hint: A Fighter took >25% HP but ended with Second Wind unused — a tactical-adherence smell. Reinforce 'use signature class features when warranted' in the DM/angry-DM guidance. WARN only.

maneuver_rider_consumed.hint: A maneuver / to-hit rider (Battle Master superiority die, War-Domain Guided Strike) was spent via use_resource but the following attack did not fold the bonus in (the +Nd8 damage or +10 to-hit was dropped). Check the use_resource -> attack pending-bonus fold (server.py) + the DM's two-step maneuver usage. WARN only.

guiding_bolt_advantage_consumed.hint: A Guiding Bolt advantage rider LANDED on a target (attack -> on_hit_effect_applied: ['Guiding Bolt']) but the next attack against that same target did NOT carry advantage_source='Guiding Bolt' — the SRD 'next attack roll against it has Advantage' rider was dropped. The engine auto-grants + consumes it via combat.attack_modifiers + attack() (#194/#1033), so a miss means the engine attack() path was bypassed (the follow-up was narrated, not resolved through the tool) or the marker expired early. Check that the follow-up strike is resolved via attack() against the marked target within the caster's next-turn window. WARN only.

multiattack_budget_honored.hint: A creature with Extra Attack / Multiattack (extra_attacks>0) resolved fewer attacks than its budget across a combat — the Multiattack was likely truncated to a single attack. Reinforce 'resolve ALL Multiattack components under one action' in the DM/angry-DM guidance + check the combat-sprint seed. WARN only.

caster_exercised_spellcasting.hint: A leveled caster (has spell_slots / spells_known) went a whole multi-beat run without a single cast_spell — a coverage omission (the caster never used magic). Reinforce spell usage in the DM guidance + the seed. WARN only.

death_saves_rolled_when_downed.hint: A PC ended at 0 HP, not dead and not stable, with no roll_death_save call — the death-save mechanic was narrated but never rolled. Check the DM's downed-creature handling + the roll_death_save path. WARN only.

concentration_dropped_cleanly.hint: A character ended still concentrating with >1 own concentration effect active and no drop_concentration call — a second concentration spell should have dropped the first. Reinforce concentration management + the drop_concentration tool in the DM guidance. WARN only.

signature_feature_exercised.hint: A seeded signature pool (channel_divinity / action_surge / second_wind) was never used the whole session — a coverage omission. The combat seed should exercise it. Check the combat-sprint seed prompt + use_resource path. WARN only.

parry_reaction_considered.hint: A melee hit landed on a parry-capable monster but no parry/reaction fired all fight — the monster's reaction was never used. Reinforce monster-reaction usage in the DM/angry-DM guidance; confirm the reaction path in combat.py. WARN only.

ranged_disadvantage_in_melee.hint: A ranged shot fired in melee (mutual-melee proxy => adjacency) without disadvantage. OFF-grid (theater-of-mind) this is a DM-adherence WARN — reinforce the ranged-in-melee disadvantage rule in the DM/angry-DM guidance; the proxy can mis-fire on a genuine gap. ON a grid (#461 PR-5) the engine AUTO-APPLIES the rule in server.py attack() and surfaces attack_roll.ranged_in_melee_disadvantage; the check reads that field so a grid run passes by construction. WARN only.
